scope: Read-only source audit of TC6 BETA26 and alpha9.16 implementation; runtime client verification is a separate task. Differences below describe the baseline before current edits.

activation.right_click: Client immediately calls drawFX and plays thaumcraft:scan at player position, PLAYERS category, volume0.5 pitch1, distanceDelayfalse; server independently calls doScan; return SUCCESS.
activation.cooldown: No scanner-specific cooldown or sustained use duration in original ItemThaumometer. Vanilla input repeat delay is separate.

entity_target.line_of_sight: Eye to entity eye; walls reject target. Select nearest ray intersection; entity priority over block.

activation.block_target: Vanilla Item rayTrace(player,true): includes liquids; standard interaction reach.
activation.blank_target: ScanningManager.scanTheThing(player,null) still runs handlers (ScanSky); if none accept, purple italic tc.unknownobject.

scan_rules.dispatch: Runs all registered IScanThing handlers. A check with a research key succeeds only when progressResearch newly progresses it. Blank/null key suppresses generic status. onSuccess runs for accepted handlers.
scan_rules.generic_scan: Requires nonempty aspects. Item research key uses registry name and metadata for non-damageable items; ordinary entity key uses registered entity name. Awards category observation formula once.
scan_rules.aspect_scan: Independent handler per aspect; +1 OBSERVATION each to AUROMANCY,BASICS,ALCHEMY once per aspect.
scan_rules.special_scans: Enchantments, potion/effect instances, entity class predicates, ore dictionary materials, registered blocks/items, and celestial scan can progress independent of generic aspect scan.
scan_rules.sky: Requires no object, pitch<=0, open sky above player, OVERWORLD dimension type, completed CELESTIALSCANNING. Sun/moon angular tolerances10deg yaw/7deg pitch; night otherwise maps horizontal direction to stars. Requires paper + scribing tools but consumes only paper. Once per celestial type/day; removes older CEL_* keys. Accepted blank research key suppresses generic status.

activation_runes.rotation: one of four90deg Y orientations, then90degZ; fixed world plane
activation_runes.glyph: random16 glyphs, original particle atlas64grid cols0..15 row6

idle_highlight.block_ray: 16blocks with yaw and pitch random nextInt25-nextInt25

aura.flux_warning: flux>vis OR flux>integer(base/3), and FLUX research not yet known; start research with popup plus DARK_PURPLE research.FLUX.warn
aura.dial: Base/Vis/Flux normalized by525, clamped, rescale if sum>1. 16x80 frame, animated additive bars. Crouch shows numeric Vis/Flux at halfscale. Flux scroll tick/3 + partialTick (not (tick+partialTick)/3).

world_readout.entity: World-space aspect billboards above target entity, not screen-center HUD. No scan/discovered gate. Uses AspectHelper.getEntityAspects, which does NOT derive dropped ItemEntity stack aspects. Max5perrow, insertion order, yaw-facing, alpha.75, packedlight220, animated tagscale.
world_readout.block: RenderEventHandler.blockTags renderer exists but no writers found anywhere in the complete decompiled archive. General block item aspect readout is not demonstrably active in this original. Goggles container aspect display is a separate mechanic.

shift_tooltip.sort: Stable descending amount (ties retain insertion order)
shift_tooltip.quantity: Default half-scale white text with four cardinal black outline; largeTagText option disabled by default.
shift_tooltip.latin_aspect_names: Original aspect IDs/tags preserved; graphics draw fullcolored glyphs.

routes: Explicit Thaumcraft API object aspect registration
cross_mod_aspects.examples: Copper/tin/silver/lead/brass/bronze/steel, ores/dusts/gems, logs/leaves/saplings receive base material aspects through common OreDictionary keys.
cross_mod_aspects.recipe_formula: Sum first ingredient variants; subtract recipe remainders; multiply by0.75/outputCount; truncate except .75<v<1 rounds to1; choose positive recipe with lowesttotal aspects. Crucible and infusion add sqrt(visCost)/outputCount. Recursive history stops at100, cap500peraspect, cull to7types.
cross_mod_aspects.limits: A raw item with no explicit/shared/material registration, no productive supported recipe and no semantic item bonus mayremainwithoutaspects. Unknown custom machine recipes are not universal. Original ordinary smelting is not in generateTagsFromRecipes.

baseline_priority_differences.difference: No Shift item aspect tooltip registered in port.
Port server-only FX packet delays local scan feedback and enforces scanner-specific10tick cooldown.
Port rune center is0.5block too low; smallentity duration clamped to>=15 instead of int(height*15).
Port idle scan_spark generic particle lasts6..9ticks/shrinks/alwaysuses320 instead of original delayed16..19tick randomflicker/growth/mixedglyphs.
Port screen-center scanned/discovered-gated aspect row differs from original entity world billboards.
Port generic miss produces no unknownobject message; generic statuses lack originalcolor+italic; container slotmessages suppressed.
Minor aura flux fractionalscroll and base/3integer threshold.

original_quirks_not_to_silently_claim_pa: held=isSelected||itemSlot==0 also activates scanner in inactive firsthotbarslot; genuine hand check is safer but intentionaldifference.
thaumTarget isnot cleared when scanner removed; staleentity overlaycanpersist. Modernimplementation should clear staleclienttarget.
Some general block overlaycode isdead; sourcepresence alone isnot featureconfirmation.
